transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the disposition for the 600 totes from yesterday's sanitation cycle. As you know, this batch was cleaned with the wrong alkaline chemical and is currently segregated from normal inventory. Before I approve any disposition plan, I need quality engineering and production control to report your findings. Quality engineering — what do we know about the chemical impact on the totes and any verification results? And production control — what's the current inventory status and are there any customer shipment commitments we need to be aware of?

transcript.text: I completed my swab and rinse-water review this morning. Here's what I found: 140 totes have absorbed chemical residue and must be scrapped. I should also note that the signed lab worksheet has not yet been attached to the disposition record, so I'll need to get that uploaded before we finalize anything.
